objective: A frozen exploratory sweep: every linear rule on each ring and every law at each contact, with all four rings growing together (middle-ring contacts antipodal for 3 to 9 cells, or two apart for 4 to 9) and with paths growing longer (4 to 9 rings); full counts at the two smallest sizes of each schedule, and every family native there followed to the largest size. Is any family native at every size?
status: Closed: supported 2026-11-08 (exploratory; H1 fails): no family is native at every size of its schedule. With all four rings of 3, 4 or 5 cells no path is native at all (0 of 36,864,000, every linear rule and law, middle contacts antipodal or two apart); of the longer families (end rings 3, middle rings 5), 8 are native at 4 rings, the known construction, and none at 5 rings (0 of 1,024,000).
title: Families of paths native at every size
